articles.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
articles.snippet: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

articles.title: Wall Street rethinks AI data center boom as Texas election raises new risks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miners pivoting to AI face new uncertainty over power access and construction permits, while companies with approved projects could benefit from tighter supply.

articles.title: THORChain's RUNE jumps 10% as North Korean hackers resume laundering Binance loot
articles.snippet: North Korea’s TraderTraitor is routing Binance hack proceeds through THORChain, swapping ether for bitcoin after an earlier wave of conversions from Tron.

articles.title: Elon Musk floats space data centers as Democratic sweep puts pressure on AI trade
articles.snippet: Texas election result raises fears of data centre restrictions, while Musk and Palihapitiya draw attention to the space economy.

articles.title: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange’s founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.
